NUMBERS 71+
2016-09-02T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-weekend/numbers/numbers-71-1279327

71+ is the number of people killed in Yemeni city of Aden. An explosives-laden car rammed into an army recruiting centre in 29th August, 2016 and the explosion killed more than 71 people and injured another 98 people. It is the deadliest terrorist attack on any Yemeni city in over a year.
